title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: The Claim Time Bar
content:
Every tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` sets an outer limit, counted in calendar months from delivery, after which no claim can be admitted.

## Rule

- **Anchor.** The delivery date recorded on the cover.
- **The time bar date.** Count the tier's time bar months forward from the delivery date and take the same day of the month. Where the month reached has no such day, the time bar date is that month's last day.
- **Comparison.** A notice dated on the time bar date is in time. A notice dated after it is rejected as time barred.
- **Evidence.** Both dates come from the line's records: the delivery date on the cover and the notice date on the claim file.

| Tier | Time bar (calendar months after delivery) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 12 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 12 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 12 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 12 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 18 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 24 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Tier | Delivery date | Time bar date | Notice dated | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 14 April 2026 | 14 April 2027 | 14 April 2027 | in time |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 14 April 2026 | 14 April 2027 | 15 April 2027 | time barred |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 31 August 2025 | 28 February 2027, as that February has no 31st | 28 February 2027 | in time |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 31 August 2025 | 28 February 2027 | 1 March 2027 | time barred |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 5 January 2026 | 5 January 2028 | 4 January 2028 | in time |
